paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Графиката илюстрира промяната на стойност по отношение на друга стойност. Оста X е обозначена като „Rank“ и представя линейна скала с диапазон от 4 до 256. Етикетите по оста X са числа, разположени на равни интервали от 4, 16, 64 и 256. Оста Y е обозначена като „Traces × 10⁻⁵ (RTE)“ и представя линейна скала с диапазон от 0.0 до 6.0. Етикетите по оста Y са числа, разположени на равни интервали от 0.0, 3.0 и 6.0.

На графиката е изобразена една черна линия с кръгли маркери. Линията започва в точката (4, 2.0), след което намалява до (16, 1.0). Следва увеличение до (64, 2.0) и завършва в точката (256, 3.2). На всяка от точките (4, 16, 64, 256) има грешка, представена като оранжева хоризонтална линия, простираща се нагоре и надолу от съответната точка.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between “Rank” and “Traces × 10⁻⁵ (RTE)”. The x-axis is labeled “Rank”, has a linear scale, a value range from 4 to 256, and tick labels at intervals of 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis is labeled “Traces × 10⁻⁵ (RTE)”, has a linear scale, a value range from 0.0 to 6.0, and tick labels at intervals of 1.0.  A black solid line with orange circular markers begins at approximately (4, 2.5) and decreases to approximately (16, 1.5). It then increases to approximately (64, 2.0) before rising to approximately (256, 3.2). Error bars, represented by horizontal orange lines, are present at each data point, with lengths consistent across all ranks.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Beziehung zwischen Rang und Traces × 10⁻⁵ (RTE). Die x-Achse ist als "Rang" beschriftet und skaliert linear von 4 bis 256, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 4, 16, 64 und 256 dargestellt werden. Die y-Achse ist als "Traces × 10⁻⁵ (RTE)" beschriftet und skaliert linear von 0,0 bis 6,0, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0,0, 3,0 und 6,0 dargestellt werden. Eine einzelne schwarze Linie, die mit quadratischen Markierungen gekennzeichnet ist, ist im Diagramm dargestellt. Bei einem Rang von 4 beträgt der Wert auf der y-Achse etwa 2,3 × 10⁻⁵, der Wert sinkt auf etwa 1,2 × 10⁻⁵ bei einem Rang von 16, steigt dann auf etwa 1,7 × 10⁻⁵ bei einem Rang von 64 und steigt schließlich auf etwa 3,4 × 10⁻⁵ bei einem Rang von 256.
